evals.name: delegate-inplace
evals.prompt: このリポジトリの失敗してるテストを GLM-5.2 に直させて、何をどう直したか結果を見せて。
evals.expected_output: Ordinary work delegation → inplace: --cwd is the live working tree, acp_run.py --agent opencode --model opencode-go/glm-5.2, review git diff there; no worktree unless user asked for isolation.

evals.name: verify-skill-isolated
evals.prompt: keep-a-changelog スキルを OpenCode Go の glm-5.2 で完遂できるか検証して。ライブのブランチは汚さないで。
evals.expected_output: Skill verification → isolated worktree (or cp -Rc), stage keep-a-changelog skill files into the copy, prompt the model to follow SKILL.md, run acp_run.py, report pass/fail from outcomes; usually no promote; teardown worktree.

evals.name: compare-two-models
evals.prompt: この関数のリファクタを Qwen3.7 Max と DeepSeek V4 Pro の両方にやらせて、出力の違いを比較したい。
evals.expected_output: Always isolated: two separate sandboxed sequential acp_run.py runs; then compare outputs with model_verified for each.

evals.name: second-opinion-review
evals.prompt: opencode 経由で別ベンダーのモデルに、いま書いたこの変更のレビューを頼みたい。
evals.expected_output: Delegation-style review → inplace on the live tree (or isolated only if user asked not to touch the branch); uses bundled client, returns external model feedback.
